text:
zara: kicking off a short thread to lock the benchmark hero + launch flow. goal: clear narrative for product PMs (cost predictability) and infra (latency knobs).

matt: timeline/asks?

zara: need hero visual, 3 microcards (chat/search/rerank), 2 headline variants for A/B, webinar outline, and routing rules.

ivy: propose hero = scatter (x=median ms, y=$/1k tokens), color by use-case, dotted box for our SLA sweet spot. include a small inset waterfall showing batching+cache deltas.

ben: can we use log scale for latency if we include heavy outliers? makes spacing easier.

claire: copy variants: A) "Predictable token economics for shipped features" B) "Meet latency SLAs without surprise bills". we'll AB headline + subject line.

ivy: rough points for mock (layout only):
```
model,median_ms,cost_per_1k,use_case
red-8k,50,0.055,chat
red-13b,115,0.078,search
open-13b-q4,92,0.049,rerank
mini-gpt,240,0.135,batch
```

matt: webinar: 20m tuning demo (caching + batching), 15m customer example, 15m live Q&A. CTA: download benchmark kit + try Dedicated trial.

ben: routing: webinar signups with >25 seats -> AE; kit downloads with company domain -> SDR; others -> nurture drip (3 emails). capture primary_use_case on form.

zara: design asks: hero PNG 1200x628, microcards in 600x400 slots, GIF showing p95 improvement after prefix cache. annotate SLA band.

claire: methodology blurb for page: "Median & p95 measured over steady-state runs (30-60m) at 50-200 qps. costs include batching and cache effects. anonymized customer data optional."

ivy: supporting stats to cite: prefix-cache ~24% token reduction on search slice; batching @150 qps ~17% cost delta. i'll post final CSV by EOD.

matt: analytics: track hero headline variant, kit downloads, trial starts, AE handoffs. build a simple funnel in Looker for visibility.

zara: action owners: ivy -> final CSV by 3pm, claire -> hero comps by 5pm, ben -> routing + GTM tags by EOD, matt -> funnel setup by Tue. i'll draft short blog + tweet after hero lands.

benchbot: bench-run-5876 complete. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/5876/preview.png :white_check_mark:

zara: great. small async check-in only. shout if anything blocks. :sparkles:
